title: Suavity
summary: SUAVITY, noun [Latin] 1. Sweetness, in a literal sense. [Not in use.] 2. Sweetness, in a figurative sense; that which is to the mind what sweetness is to the tongue; agreeableness; softness; pleasantn

inlines.v: SUAVITY, noun [Latin] 1. Sweetness, in a literal sense. [Not in use.] 2. Sweetness, in a figurative sense; that which is to the mind what sweetness is to the tongue; agreeableness; softness; pleasantness; as suavity of manners; suavity of language, conversation or address.
